segments.thi-ap13:1.3: Mama bhāgaṃ gahetvāna, gacchaṃ udakahārikā [udakahārikaṃ (sī.), udakahārike (syā.)].
segments.thi-ap13:4.1: “Sampatti taṃ [sampattiñca (syā.), sampattikaṃ (ka.)] karitvāna, sabbaṃ anubhaviṃ ahaṃ;
segments.thi-ap13:4.3: Modake tīṇi datvāna, pattāhaṃ acalaṃ padaṃ.
segments.thi-ap13:6.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap13:8.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ modakadāyikā bhikkhunī imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
